data.title: PR-16 calculus crash step WorkerStep::Crash replacing the lift's Resume approximation

data.body: [info][risk assessment] Failure modes: illegal terminal or finalized-region crashes, cleanup execution during cancellation, staged-publication survival, adapter-obligation laundering, and lift-injected task steps. The guards at region.rs:1103-1250 refuse terminal/finalized transitions, admit a fail-stop crash across all nonterminal cancellation phases, discard staged slots, retain substrate obligations, and settle through the sole terminal transition. Edge cases: Created, Running, and Suspended workers across active, requested, and acknowledged cancellation; staged and committed evidence; terminal workers; finalized regions; and crashed obligation holders are covered by the changed tests and independent oracle. Rollback: revert dbc619cc and 91063838 to restore the prior Resume-then-Fail lift approximation; journal encoding, schemas, and wire protocol are unchanged. Monitoring: track Refused, Unsupported, and InsufficientTelemetry lift outcomes around region-crashed events, especially stopped-set, fence, cancellation, deadline, and channel mismatches. Validation: keep canonical FailureReason validation, exact worker and region lookup, exact stopped-set checks, cancellation/deadline/channel exclusions, ordered fence checks, and mutation/differential coverage. No security blocker found. This static LGTM does not replace any risk:critical human approval.
